verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a `/cases` endpoint for programmatically creating and managing transaction disputes, using a typed details object, but only on the Mastercard network. It also documents general API-event webhooks sent to a customer-hosted endpoint, though nothing ties them to dispute status. Most of the story's specific elements are absent from the evidence. Missing for 10: network reason-code handling, evidence/document submission, provisional credit handling, dispute-specific status webhooks through resolution, non-Mastercard network coverage, independent corroboration.
